title: Rebate for LEED or other environmental design certification.
officialText:
Owners who demonstrate certification of their
project, which was signed off following the effective date of this code, by the United States Green Building Council based
upon the Council’s Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) rating system or as otherwise provided by rule,
may be rebated their fees as set out in rule.
